ModMetaData.name: Lone Survivor
ModMetaData.author: William
ModMetaData.description:
Lone Survivor empowers small colonies and solo survivors by granting dynamic buffs that scale inversely with your population.
FEATURES: - Dynamic Population Scaling: Maximum buff at 1 colonist (+200% Work Speed, +100% Learning Rate, -50% Rest Fall Rate). - Seamless Diminishing Buff: The buff smoothly scales down as new members join, and is automatically removed when your population reaches the configured threshold. - Highly Configurable: Fine-tune population thresholds, work speed bonus, learning factor, fatigue reduction, movement bonus, and immunity gain directly in Mod Settings.
